about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Cybersecurity Technologist student at IAE and a Web Development Technological Baccalaureate graduate from ÁNIMA.

My experience goes beyond code: I worked in eCommerce and Marketing support at Tu Ración, analyzed Mercado Libre data at Arbusta and handled real-time monitoring at Sportradar. That's why I treat every website as a business tool.

timeline.text: Applied security: data protection and secure-by-design practices.
Solid web development foundation: from semantic HTML to complete applications.
Hands-on experience in what makes an online store sell: catalog, customer care and messages that convert.
Analysis of large data volumes to decide with numbers, not intuition.
Attention to detail and calm under pressure where every second counts.
